ru.text: У меня никогда не было такого рода опыта

en.text: Fill in the form, please!

en.text: What is he eating now?

en.text: He's just apologized for his rude behaviour

en.text: He's just made a mistake

en.text: I felt that I needed much more practice

en.text: You can copy other people's mistakes there

en.text: When I came there, I realized that I had missed the bus

en.text: I haven't chosen the answer yet

en.text: I haven't noticed any serious changes yet

en.text: He's borrowed a very big sum of money this month

en.text: He tries to travel every year

ru.text: Мальчик играл в эту игру весь день

en.text: The boy was playing this game all day
